text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the final showdown!!!
Though the three of us were born in different lands!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Our dreams are the same!!
To forge our own era!
And then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"What I'm aiming for is victory, of course!
I'm prepared to win at all costs, but if, by some chance, I should fall..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lady Dantsu! Mirako!
Surpass this and achieve victory!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I know I'm usually daydreaming, but...
today...! Just for today...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'll do it! I'm gonna show everyone what I'm made of!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Me too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The one standing at the center of the stage today
is nobody else. —It is me!
choice_data_list: Let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOH!!!!

The sheer weight of emotion and morale poured into today was extraordinary.
Every last one of them had a wild glint in their eyes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Hmph—So you've arrived.
No Reason.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, that look on your face is the absolute best!
You're completely dialed in, aren't you?

Such a distinguished lineup.
This showdown—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I, Agnes Digital,
will bear witness to this!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Agnes Digital-dono, the fellow Umamusume lover!
Having thee here is truly reassuring!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you turn it into a doujin picture scroll.
This Takarazuka Kinen is our Sekigahara...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: No matter who wins, it will surely be a showdown for the history books.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Tell them! Tell them of how we lived—dreaming of the world, running with single-minded devotion!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, as you wish~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Behold—our stride and our spirits!!
Chaaaaarge!!"

"A Takarazuka Kinen with a roster this stacked
doesn't happen often. Among them—"

"To stand at the forefront of the next generation,
victory is paramount. With two allies in tow,
No Reason dashes forward."
